```{=html}
<dialog id="code-breaker-dialog" class="code-breaker-dialog" aria-labelledby="code-breaker-title">
<div class="code-breaker-dialog-header">
  <div>
    <span class="project-card-kicker">Mini game</span>
    <span id="code-breaker-title" class="code-breaker-title">Code Breaker</span>
  </div>
  <div class="code-breaker-dialog-actions">
    <button id="code-breaker-fullscreen" class="code-breaker-tool-button" type="button" aria-label="Enter fullscreen">[ ]</button>
    <button id="code-breaker-close" class="code-breaker-close" type="button" aria-label="Close Code Breaker">X</button>
  </div>
</div>

<p class="code-breaker-intro">Guess the secret code without being told which digits you got right. You have 10 attempts.</p>

<div class="code-breaker-board">
<form id="code-breaker-form" class="code-breaker-form">
  <label for="code-guess">Your guess
    <input id="code-guess" name="guess" type="text" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="4" pattern="[0-9]{4}" placeholder="0000" autocomplete="off" required>
  </label>
  <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Check guess</button>
</form>

<p id="code-breaker-status" class="code-breaker-status" role="status" aria-live="polite">You have 10 attempts.</p>

  <div class="scoreboard-heading">Guess history</div>
  <div class="scoreboard-legend">
    <span><i class="score-peg score-peg-exact" aria-hidden="true"></i> Right position</span>
    <span><i class="score-peg score-peg-partial" aria-hidden="true"></i> Wrong position</span>
  </div>
</div>

<table class="code-breaker-table">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th scope="col">Guess</th>
      <th scope="col">Scoreboard</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody id="code-breaker-history"></tbody>
</table>

<button id="code-breaker-new-game" class="btn btn-outline-light code-breaker-new-game" type="button">New game</button>
 </div>
</dialog>
```

<script>
(() => {
  const card = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-card");
  const dialog = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-dialog");
  const fullscreen = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-fullscreen");
  const close = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-close");
  const form = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-form");
  const input = document.querySelector("#code-guess");
  const status = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-status");
  const history = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-history");
  const newGame = document.querySelector("#code-breaker-new-game");
  const maxAttempts = 10;
  let secretCode;
  let attempts;
  let gameOver;

  function makeCode() {
    return Array.from({ length: 4 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 10)).join("");
  }

  function scoreGuess(guess) {
    let rightPosition = 0;
    const remainingSecret = [];
    const remainingGuess = [];

    for (let index = 0; index < secretCode.length; index += 1) {
      if (guess[index] === secretCode[index]) {
        rightPosition += 1;
      } else {
        remainingSecret.push(secretCode[index]);
        remainingGuess.push(guess[index]);
      }
    }

    const secretCounts = {};
    const guessCounts = {};
    remainingSecret.forEach((digit) => {
      secretCounts[digit] = (secretCounts[digit] || 0) + 1;
    });
    remainingGuess.forEach((digit) => {
      guessCounts[digit] = (guessCounts[digit] || 0) + 1;
    });

    const wrongPosition = Object.keys(guessCounts).reduce(
      (total, digit) => total + Math.min(guessCounts[digit] || 0, secretCounts[digit] || 0),
      0
    );

    return { rightPosition, wrongPosition };
  }

  function makeBall(digit) {
    const ball = document.createElement("span");
    ball.className = `digit-ball digit-ball-${digit}`;
    ball.textContent = digit;
    ball.setAttribute("aria-label", `digit ${digit}`);
    return ball;
  }

  function makeScorePegs(score) {
    const pegs = document.createElement("span");
    pegs.className = "score-pegs";
    pegs.setAttribute("aria-label", `${score.rightPosition} right position, ${score.wrongPosition} wrong position`);
    const exactGroup = document.createElement("span");
    exactGroup.className = "score-group";
    exactGroup.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    for (let index = 0; index < score.rightPosition; index += 1) {
      const peg = document.createElement("i");
      peg.className = "score-peg score-peg-exact";
      exactGroup.append(peg);
    }
    const exactCount = document.createElement("strong");
    exactCount.className = "score-count score-count-exact";
    exactCount.textContent = score.rightPosition;
    exactGroup.append(exactCount);

    const partialGroup = document.createElement("span");
    partialGroup.className = "score-group";
    partialGroup.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    for (let index = 0; index < score.wrongPosition; index += 1) {
      const peg = document.createElement("i");
      peg.className = "score-peg score-peg-partial";
      partialGroup.append(peg);
    }
    const partialCount = document.createElement("strong");
    partialCount.className = "score-count score-count-partial";
    partialCount.textContent = score.wrongPosition;
    partialGroup.append(partialCount);
    pegs.append(exactGroup, partialGroup);
    return pegs;
  }

  function startGame() {
    secretCode = makeCode();
    attempts = 0;
    gameOver = false;
    history.replaceChildren();
    status.textContent = `You have ${maxAttempts} attempts.`;
    input.disabled = false;
    form.querySelector("button").disabled = false;
    input.value = "";
    if (dialog.open) input.focus();
  }

  card.addEventListener("click", () => {
    dialog.showModal();
    startGame();
  });

  close.addEventListener("click", () => dialog.close());

  fullscreen.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    if (document.fullscreenElement) {
      await document.exitFullscreen();
    } else if (dialog.requestFullscreen) {
      await dialog.requestFullscreen();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", () => {
    const isFullscreen = document.fullscreenElement === dialog;
    fullscreen.textContent = isFullscreen ? "[ ]" : "[ ]";
    fullscreen.setAttribute("aria-label", isFullscreen ? "Exit fullscreen" : "Enter fullscreen");
  });

  dialog.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    if (event.target === dialog) dialog.close();
  });

  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (gameOver) return;

    const guess = input.value;
    if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(guess)) {
      status.textContent = "Enter exactly four digits.";
      input.focus();
      return;
    }

    attempts += 1;
    const score = scoreGuess(guess);
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    const guessCell = document.createElement("td");
    guessCell.className = "guess-balls";
    Array.from(guess).forEach((digit) => guessCell.append(makeBall(digit)));
    const scoreCell = document.createElement("td");
    scoreCell.append(makeScorePegs(score));
    row.append(guessCell, scoreCell);
    history.prepend(row);

    if (score.rightPosition === 4) {
      status.textContent = `You cracked the code in ${attempts} ${attempts === 1 ? "attempt" : "attempts"}!`;
      gameOver = true;
    } else if (attempts === maxAttempts) {
      status.textContent = `Game over. The code was ${secretCode}. Start a new game to try again.`;
      gameOver = true;
    } else {
      const remaining = maxAttempts - attempts;
      status.textContent = `${score.rightPosition} digit${score.rightPosition === 1 ? "" : "s"} in the right position, ${score.wrongPosition} in the wrong position. ${remaining} attempts left.`;
    }

    input.value = "";
    input.disabled = gameOver;
    form.querySelector("button").disabled = gameOver;
  });

  newGame.addEventListener("click", startGame);
  startGame();
})();
</script>
